2610.11312.title: MedBenchAgent: Towards Systematic Automation of Medical VLM Benchmark Construction
2610.11312.paper_summary: Large-scale construction of medical vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks is increasingly feasible with richly annotated imaging datasets and large language models (LLMs), yet existing automation largely focuses on generating evaluation items within predefined benchmark specifications. We study the broader problem of automatically deriving the specification itself: what to evaluate, which annotations support each task, and how to translate this evidence into reliable evaluation items. We formulate benchmark construction as constrained compilation, in which the benchmark specification is progressively derived from evaluation requirements, heterogeneous annotations, and medical knowledge. Based on this formulation, we introduce MedBenchAgent, a multi-agent framework with a Benchmark Intermediate Representation (BIR) that encodes task definitions, evidence mappings, evaluation protocols, and item specifications across construction stages. MedBenchAgent separates planning, which derives and verifies the specification, from instantiation, which constructs and audits items under the locked specification. MedBenchAgent achieves a Task-Space F1 of 90.9%, outperforming direct task induction (79.2-80.0%) and prior-guided induction (85.1%); 994 of 1,000 sampled items from correctly identified tasks pass human audit. We further demonstrate portability to a specialized medical domain and evaluate twelve VLMs, revealing task- and setting-specific variation obscured by aggregate scores. These results establish constrained compilation as a scalable and auditable framework for medical VLM benchmark construction beyond question generation.
2610.11312.paper_summary_zh: 大型醫療視覺-語言模型（VLM）基準的建設隨著豐富註釋的影像數據集和大型語言模型（LLMs）變得越來越可行，但現有的自動化主要集中在生成預定基準規範內的評估項目。我們研究自動推導規範本身的更廣泛問題：評估什麼、哪些註釋支持每個任務，以及如何將這些證據轉化為可靠的評估項目。我們將基準建設公式化為受限編譯，其中基準規範是根據評估要求、異質註釋和醫學知識逐步推導的。基於這一公式，我們介紹了MedBenchAgent，一個多代理框架，具有基準中介表示（BIR），該表示編碼了任務定義、證據映射、評估協議和建設階段的項目規範。MedBenchAgent將規劃（推導和驗證規範）與實例化（在鎖定的規範下構建和審核項目）分開。MedBenchAgent實現了90.9%的任務空間F1，超越了直接任務誘導（79.2-80.0%）和先前引導的誘導（85.1%）；從正確識別的任務中抽樣的1,000個項目中，有994個通過了人工審核。我們進一步展示了在專門醫療領域的可移植性，並評估了十二個VLM，揭示了被總體分數掩蓋的任務和設置特定的變異。這些結果確立了受限編譯作為醫療VLM基準建設的一個可擴展和可審核的框架，超越了問題生成。
